_comment: Editorial content for SRR. This is a REIT scheme, not an operating company: it is a trust managed by a licensed REIT Management Company, so the fields below describe the scheme and its manager. It has no products of its own. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached.
description: Signature Residency REIT (SRR) is a rated, Shariah-compliant, closed-end developmental REIT scheme with a limited life of indicatively four years from 22 March 2023, established by a trust deed of 6 March 2023 between Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management Limited, as the REIT Management Company, and the Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited, as trustee. It was formed on two land parcels in Naya Nazimabad, Karachi — Com 102 and Com 109/1 — totalling 4,088 square yards, to build and sell apartments and retail units. Com 109/1 was sold in November 2024, leaving Com 102 of 2,067 square yards, on which the Signature Residency Apartments project is being built. Its fund size is PKR 330 million across 8,250,000 units of PKR 10 each, and it listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on 29 January 2026.
headOffice: Arif Habib Centre, 23 M.T. Khan Road, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Signature Residency REIT Offer for Sale Document (PSX-hosted, January 2026) and the PSX Data Portal security record for SRR, read 2026-10-17.
